dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Can you help me find a place to eat? Italian or Japanese would both be fine.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Happy to help. I can see places by the station and by the mall.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: It's for dinner. I also need vegetarian options.

evaluation_only.contrast_note: A: station -> R06 Trattoria Lucca ($22); mall -> R02 Hoshi Sushi Bar ($24), R07 Nonna's Kitchen ($27), R09 Osteria Verde ($34); nothing near both -> ask. B: lunch instead of dinner makes R08 Forno Pizza ($16) valid for both -> recommend it. All -H variants share this chat and enumerate the hidden targets (main's nlp-quota-v3 format).

turn_plan.speaker: assistant
turn_plan.act: assistant mentions both areas (station first, mall second); not a user choice

turn_plan.speaker: user
turn_plan.act: user: 'Something around that area, please.' = station or mall (UNRESOLVED; hidden: station)

predefined_clarification_answers.cuisine: Either Italian or Japanese is fine.
predefined_clarification_answers.dinner: Yes, it needs to be open for dinner.
predefined_clarification_answers._unsupported: I don't have a preference on that.
predefined_clarification_answers._multi_question: Sorry, one thing at a time - what did you want to know first?
